children: The Shangai Composite Index fell 12 points or 0.29 percent on Friday to close at 3931 points.
Leading the losses are Sanan Optoelectron (-4.68%), Aluminum Corporation of China (-1.63%) and Shanghai International Port (-1.45%).
Top gainers were Poly Real Estate (3.54%), Yonyou Soft (3.23%) and Kweichow Moutai (2.62%).

title: The Shangai Composite Index Closes 0.29% Lower
